title: D2P Pattern Proposal
description: A reviewable proposal to change a pattern, derived from a 3D edit (design decisions ADR-009 §7, ADR-021 §3). A proposal is never a pattern revision and never applied automatically (CAD-012, GAR-008, SIM-008, T3D-014): it carries no revision ID of its own and no content document. Accepting it is a separate, authorized decision that submits a 'd2p:pattern.parameters.update' command with expectedRevisionId = basePatternRef.revisionId and payload.updates = parameterUpdates; only that command creates the new pattern revision, which is validated as usual. Free mesh deformations without a parametric mapping are not proposals in this release; they are reported as ambiguous or forbidden by the edit inspection.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

basePatternRef.description: Pattern revision the proposal applies to.

inspectionRef.description: Optional reference to the d2p:inspect-3d-edit-result the proposal came from (digest = its resultDigest).

origin.description: parametric-control: a 3D control with an explicit parameter mapping (design decision ADR-009 §7, GAR-009); mapped-mesh-edit: a mesh edit that the inspection mapped to parameters.

parameterUpdates.description: Proposed parameter updates; parameter IDs resolve in the base pattern (D2P-REF-003), expressions keep the parameter's dimension (D2P-SEM-002).

rationale.description: Free-text rationale and assumptions (seam layout, flattening, material) for the reviewer.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest).
